RE: Account reference: ACC-666390

Dear [CONSUMER NAME],

Re: Dispute of Account ACC-666390

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account ACC-666390. You have disputed the amount owed on this account, citing that you did not provide written permission for the transactions included in the account. We understand that you are requesting an investigation into this matter.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. We confirm that the original creditor for this account is Summit Trust Bank, and the current balance is 1482.1. We also note that the account was charged off on 2021-03-14 and the last payment was made on 2023-04-15.

We will investigate your dispute and review the transactions included in the account. If we determine that the transactions were not properly authorized, we will take the necessary steps to correct the account and remove any unauthorized charges. We will also provide you with a revised balance statement once our investigation is complete.

You have the right to dispute this account further if you believe that our investigation does not resolve your concerns. We will continue to work with you to resolve this matter in accordance with New Jersey state law and the FDCPA.

Please note that we will provide you with a written validation of the debt, as required by the FDCPA, within the next 30 days.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]
